title: observability: refine token-level KV cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: Token-level KV cache and per-token cost/latency metrics are critical for diagnosing regressions when we roll out quantized model variants and new batching heuristics. Existing dashboards were missing clear breakdowns for cold vs warm KV cache hits, and some alert thresholds produced noisy paging during recent load tests. This PR refines queries, adds missing panels, and tunes alerts to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage.

Summary of changes: 1) Add cold/warm KV hit ratio panels to the token-level dashboard, with per-model and per-region filters. 2) Introduce per-token amortized cost panels that combine token_count, GPU_seconds, and model pricing metadata to estimate $/token breakdown. 3) Move expensive aggregation queries off the default dashboard refresh path and provide a lower-refresh "long-poll" view for heavy historical views. 4) Adjust alert thresholds for: KV-miss-rate, per-request token tail-latency (95/99), and token-cost delta vs baseline; all alerts now include a 5-minute sustained window and a severity escalation path. 5) Add unit/integration tests for the dashboard queries and update docs with interpretation guidance and playbook steps.

Checklist: - [x] Metrics queries updated and covered by tests - [x] Dashboards added/updated (Grafana JSON + terraform) - [x] Alerts tuned with runbook links - [x] Docs updated (observability/interpretation) - [x] Smoke-tested on staging with production-like load

Testing and validation: Ran staging load test (1000 RPS synthetic traces) and validated that the new panels surface regressions introduced by a controlled KV eviction experiment. Initial alert tuning reduced noise: previously ~12 noisy pages during the run; after tuning only 1 P0-worthy alert triggered (token-cost delta > 15% sustained for 10m) which matched an injected misconfiguration. Snapshot of Grafana panels and run logs attached in artifacts.

Rollback plan: revert the dashboard JSON + alert rules in the terraform module and redeploy; alerts are behind feature flags for 10% rollout initially.

Notes: this is primarily observational/config work but has small runtime-safe changes (metrics labels and aggregation windows) that are backward-compatible.

review_comments: Priya Kapoor (reviewer): Query looks good overall but the KV hit ratio grouping by model_name may be high-cardinality for some customers; can we add a fallback aggregation?
Avery Chen (author): Added a top-N model filter and a fallback 'other' bucket to keep cardinality bounded. Updated tests to assert 'other' exists when model list exceeds 50.
Marco Iglesias (reviewer): Alerts LGTM but suggest increasing the sustained window on token-cost-delta from 3m to 5m to reduce flapping; also add a silencing schedule for deploy windows.
Avery Chen (author): Increased to 5m and added deploy-window silencing to the alert metadata. Noted in runbook.
Ethan Ross (approver): Verified staging run and artifacts. Approving — this should reduce noise and give clearer triage signals.
